Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for a layered paper pop-up terrarium representing Pokemon FireRed/LeafGreen INDIGO PLATEAU EXTERIOR. Reference image is the actual map: preserve its architecture, do not invent a cathedral, museum, castle, lighthouse or generic town. Generate ONE 1536x1024 RGBA atlas, exactly 4 columns and 3 rows of separated individual craft paper cutouts, each confined well inside its 384x341 cell with at least 20px transparent margins. No background scene, no labels. Front elevation, slight top visibility on steps only. Matte colored cardstock, crisp pale cut edges, shallow overlapping sheets, fine hand-painted detail, no deep 3D volume. Consistent scale within each individual object; each cell is independent.
Row1 left-to-right: (1) LEFT HALF of the League facade: warm ochre-orange wall with three tall narrow dark blue windows and light gray vertical corner trim, flat top, no roof; (2) RIGHT HALF matching facade, also orange three narrow blue windows, no roof; (3) central projecting entrance portal, light gray angular triangular gable framing a tall double blue glass door, short semicircular pale threshold below, no columns; (4) broad single shallow pale sage-gray corrugated metal roof represented by layered parallel vertical paper ribs, rectangle with slightly sloping top-view, width about 3 times its height, no facade.
Row2: (5) tall dense green conical tree made of many overlapping scalloped paper branches; (6) small GRAY RHYDON-like guardian stone statue: stocky biped dinosaur silhouette, horn on nose, spiked head, both arms held out, on square engraved plinth, stylized flat paper relief matching the map statues; (7) short WHITE ROUND STONE BOLLARD with round cap on cylindrical base, crisp white and gray layered paper; (8) straight wide outdoor ceremonial staircase front elevation, seven pale cream steps, muted mint-green narrow side railings/posts, rectangular landing, original-map style, no sculpture.
Row3: (9) wide low warm mauve-brown rocky CLIFF TERRACE FACE, cut-paper fractured layers, grass rim on top, width 3 times height; (10) narrow hedge row of three bright green shrubs, flat paper layers; (11) soft cream cloud cutout, 3 overlapping paper layers, no string; (12) simple pale warm gray STONE PATH slab strip with several rectangular pavers in staggered rows, front top-down plane, no grass, no ornaments.
No letters, no extra buildings, no ornamental columns, no Greek architecture. Preserve true transparency between objects. Each object unconnected, wholly inside one cell.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production 1024x1024 square seamless-edge flat top-down paper terrain texture for Pokemon FireRed Indigo Plateau forecourt. NO perspective, NO diorama, NO structures, NO trees, NO stones, NO logos, NO text, NO Pokeball symbol, NO circle or round arena. Pale mint/sage green matte cardstock lawn fills the square. A straight central ceremonial walkway of small pale warm gray rectangular paper paving slabs runs vertically from top edge to bottom edge, occupies exactly middle 30 percent of image width, staggered rows, crisp shallow cut paper seams, very subtle shadow no depth shading. A short branch of the same pavers runs horizontally at about 40 percent height to both edges. Fine visible paper grain, gentle irregular hand cut edges in pavers, flat green uninterrupted along left and right edges. Clean game floor material, high detail paper fibers, faithful simple original GBA Indigo Plateau pale green and cream colors.
